messages:
Evelyn (People Ops): Quick sync for the SparkPlug Recognition pilot (micro + shoutout combo). Planning a 3-week pilot w/ lightweight $75 micro-gifts + optional public shoutout. Need final playbook + export template by Thu.
Marco (Payroll): FYI any non-payroll payout needs vendor_id or prepaid card batch. For batches under $100 we can do prepaid cards but need recipient email + country.
Sofia (Finance): We'll need budget_code and approver_email on any export. Also prefer a single CSV: name,email,org,team,amount_usd,budget_code,public_shoutout,manager_approver,recipient_country,notes.
Evelyn (People Ops): Draft playbook bullets: eligibility (FT + contractors >60d), manager approval (48h SLA), cap (max 3 micros per person / quarter), public_shoutout default = off, opt-in toggle.
Jae (Eng): Can we auto-block if a recipient would exceed $600 in 90 days? We should surface a warning on submit.
Evelyn (People Ops): Yes, the form will show a warning and require escalation checkbox for overrides.
Priya (Design): UX request: show inline examples of acceptable reasons and a tiny rubric (customer saved / process improved / team lift) to reduce vague entries.
Marco (Payroll): For international recipients choose local gift vendor when possible. Add recipient_country field and payout_preference (local_vendor / prepaid_usd / payroll).
Sofia (Finance): We'll provide GL mapping per org by EOD Wed so the dropdown can default correctly.
Evelyn (People Ops): Pilot logistics: 10 teams, 50 awards over 3 weeks. Ops will run weekly dedupe and a reconciliation with payroll every Friday.
notify-bot: Reminder set: "SparkPlug pilot starts Mon" in #people-ops at 9:00 AM PT.
Jae (Eng): I'll be pilot manager for Eng, will coordinate nominations on Mon.
Marco (Payroll): Send a test CSV with test.recipient+spark@redwood.ai and vendor TEST-VEND-12 and I'll confirm card delivery timing.
Evelyn (People Ops): Will share Airtable form link + CSV template later today. Also drafting manager email template and a 10-min demo for managers next Tue.
Sofia (Finance): One more: include a confidential internal_notes column for ops only; don't include it in public exports.
Evelyn (People Ops): Noted. Thanks team — will post final playbook and templates in this thread when ready.
